description: Find a class or member of a WebSupergoo API by name - Doc.AddImageUrl, AddImageUrl, XImage.SetFile - even partial or misspelt. Returns the matching reference pages; for an exact match, the page itself. Enumerations are found on the member pages that list their values. A name that isn't in the API (a class in an example project) gets search results instead.

name.description: The class or member name, optionally with its class: Doc.Rect, AddImageUrl, XHtmlOptions.

product.description: The product the question is about: abcpdf, imageglue, wordglue or abcocr. Set it for technical questions; tell it from the user's code (WebSupergoo.ABCpdf* namespaces or Doc objects: abcpdf), and if unsure, use abcpdf. It leaves out pages for other products and general pages about purchasing, licensing and the company - so leave it out for those questions.

name: lookup_api
title: Look up an API name
